suggestions.roleTitleVi: Chuyên viên Tự động hóa & Dữ liệu Công nghiệp
suggestions.reasoning: Drawing on the Stanford HAI (2024) and TopCV (2024) indices, while routine clerical roles face disruption, technical roles integrating physical systems with digital tools and analytics show high demand and high augmentation resilience. Your 10 years of electrical field experience in Hai Phong positions you to bridge manual electrical maintenance with modern automated and data-driven systems.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your profound troubleshooting logic, hands-on experience with control panels and inverters, and shift-work stamina match the exact needs of modern industrial facilities transitioning to smart manufacturing. Even with limited technical English and PLC experience, your practical mastery of wiring and diagrams gives you a major advantage in diagnosing physical automation faults.
